ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Joe Frazier

code.originalText: Seven-month review: six-month liver cancer surveillance ultrasound and AFP, A1c, kidney function, urine albumin and vaccines

text.paragraph: Seven-month review with the six-month liver cancer surveillance ultrasound and AFP. [S]

Mr. Frazier returns nine weeks after his preventive visit. He has taken semaglutide 1 mg weekly for four months, with metformin, lisinopril, amlodipine and atorvastatin, without missed doses or side effects. Home readings average 124/78. He has had no alcohol since March. He has lost 6.8 kg since intake. He had the six-month liver ultrasound this morning. His PSA from the preventive visit was 1.4 ng/mL, which he was told by phone, and his colonoscopy is booked for next month. He has had no leg or abdominal swelling, black stools, confusion or yellowing. [S]
